makumbura_investigation.name: Makumbura Junction
makumbura_investigation.investigation_conclusion: Makumbura Junction (ID 77) is located at (6.10699, 80.33493) in Yakkalamulla, Southern Province, Galle District (ID 78). PostGIS ST_Covers independently verifies that its coordinates lie inside Galle District boundaries. It is distinct from the Makumbura Multimodal Transport Hub in Kottawa, Colombo District. The stored district assignment (78 - Galle) is verified and correct.
